interpretation_limits: These are SFT checkpoints, before RL.
Both checkpoints and step were fixed before evaluation; no training updates or test-based modifications.
Failures were inspected after complete games. Solver labels and secrets were never policy inputs.
Order audits use each model own reached states, not an identical fixed-state panel.
Before turn5 solver values refer to a fixed continuation, not globally optimal play.
Failure categories overlap in the additional flags, but the primary categories are mutually exclusive.
A public-solver guarantee assumes correct subsequent play; it is not a demonstrated model counterfactual rescue.
Latency uses a separate serial 50-game batch-one benchmark; win-rate results use 1500 batch-eight games.

definitions.probe_required: Turn 5, more than two public-consistent answers, and best offered Q5 strictly exceeds best consistent offered Q5.
definitions.optimal: Chosen Q5 equals the best offered Q5 within 1e-12; all tied best actions count.
definitions.Q5: Number of nonempty feedback buckets / number of public-consistent answers.
definitions.missed_guarantee: On turn 5 with more than two possible answers, best offered Q5 is 1 but chosen Q5 is below 1.
definitions.closing: Choose the uniquely public-consistent answer when it is offered, across all turns.

bootstrap.unit: Answer cluster retaining all seeds and turns

calibration.definition: Closing-aware public solver best action; exact endgame values, fixed-continuation values before turn 5.

order.definition: Compare each observed decision with one reverse order and two random orders, holding its history and 64 candidate words fixed. Align probabilities by word. Flip = greedy chosen word changes; TV = 0.5 * sum(abs(p_original - p_reordered)). Each decision-permutation pair has equal weight; same-order repeats are excluded from these rates.

low_information.interpretation: Held-out diagnostic: RL-B's penalty rule applied to both policies. RL-A was trained with unshaped terminal reward; mean_training_reward here is a diagnostic return.

confidence_interval_method.cluster_size: All ordering seeds, turns and permutations for the same answer stay together.
